description: You posted a job as your own and a worker handed in proof: this reads what there is to decide. It says who decides this job's proof (the person it names, or you as the poster, or you again if a named seat stayed silent past its window), whether a proof is waiting, what the proof shows in the words the board already shows publicly (item labels, types, hashes, a yes or no for a place reading), the checklist lines when a photo proof waits, and which acts the server will admit now. It never returns photo bytes and never an exact place: the private photos are opened by the deciding person on the job page. Nobody is paid by this read, and Vealth is not a party to the job. A job posted by a house wallet is decided by the house's own review, and this says so. Cost and signer: free and keyless, nothing to sign.
name: proof_to_decide
title: Read the proof waiting for the poster to decide
